interpretation: Reviewed real-user reports with proposed controlled reproductions, not verified reproductions or confirmed current service defects. Recovery fields are test plans unless explicitly described as reporter-confirmed. Version-dependent attempts require availability checks; an unavailable managed version must be marked blocked, not silently replaced. Mechanism adaptations are not reproductions of historical managed rollouts.

evidenceLabels.K: Kubernetes-sufficient candidate for the stated proximate diagnosis
evidenceLabels.O: Observability-required candidate for the stated external attribution; not observability-only verified

review.reviewBasis: Issue-body descriptions and targeted reproduction/configuration sections. Full comment threads and attachments were not reviewed for every case. Reporter claims are not independent service-defect verification. Source snapshots and search results are retained privately.

notAdmitted.reason: StorageClass SKU expectation after upgrade; no distinct demonstrated workload failure beyond the admitted zonal attachment case.
Overlapping Azure Files token-audience failure; retain as corroboration for AKS-C011 rather than a second case.
Reporter explicitly cannot reproduce the managed RBAC migration on a fresh cluster; manual damage would not reproduce that rollout.
Webhook has no endpoints, but the report does not establish a controllable origin of the regional intermittent failure.
Multiple intermittent frontend/restart failures with uncertain mechanism; prioritize the more specific subnet-association restart case AKS-C018.
Orphaned LocalDNS process and restart failure are observed, but a reliable bounded trigger for the unclean cgroup state is not established.
Priority-expander report does not establish the full effective autoscaler configuration or eligibility of competing pools.
Reporter explicitly says LocalDNS issue is not consistently reproducible; current evidence does not isolate the intermittent trigger.
Complex two-Gateway/cert-manager arrangement needs a smaller causal reproducer before admission.
Disabling ingress gateway is not necessarily disabling the mesh; insufficient separation of expected retained istiod and the reported CLI error.
Snapshot restore AuthorizationFailure overlaps AKS-C071; independent NFS-specific cause not yet established.
Report conflates anonymous blob access with public network access; requires corrected property-level evidence before a fault claim.
Migration question corroborates key-rotation risk, already represented by observed failure AKS-C082.
Multi-terabyte/million-file prolonged mount has no validated smaller bounded reproducer in the reviewed evidence.
Static workload-identity mount configuration alone does not isolate the failure from handle, role, or token setup in the reviewed material.
Overlapping expansion-condition behavior; prioritize the explicit repeated-detached-expansion reproducer AKS-C086.
Stuck source-protection finalizer has no established initiating snapshot-controller failure; removing the finalizer is not a causal reproducer.
Authentication without injection may use a different credential path; report does not establish which identity actually authorized the operation.
Hours/days-later token loss is unresolved and lacks a bounded causal trigger.
Intermittent federation failure despite matching configuration; do not recast it as the reproducible issuer mismatch in AKS-C093.

candidates.sourceTitle: [BUG] ACStor creates a separate install of Flux? This really messes up short names.
